implementation_notes: Kept pages private. It returns the integer quotient unchanged for zero or an exact multiple and adds one only for a nonzero remainder.
Used division and remainder instead of adding size-1 to items, so rounding remains correct near the maximum int.

Replaced the existing partial-page test with eight independent expected-value subtests covering zero, below-page-size, exact page, exact multiple, partial page, unit page size, and maximum-int boundaries.
Observed the regression suite fail against the original implementation on zero items and exact multiples before changing production code.
Added concise README usage examples, input preconditions, and the test command.
Changes are limited to this module and this report; no commits, installations, or external actions.
